t: A powerful router board for building your own fast home network.
steps: Buy the board from the AliExpress SINOVOIP store or the complete kit from the BPI Shop for about 370 US dollars.
Get a 12 volt barrel power supply, a heatsink with a fan, and a microSD card.
Add the Wi-Fi 7 card for wireless use. It is a separate purchase.
Download the OpenWrt image that matches your memory size from the Banana Pi docs.
Write the image to the microSD card with an image writing app.
Boot the board and connect a computer to a network port.
Open the OpenWrt web page in a browser and set up your first network.
meta: Open Board. From $370. A few stores.
